entries.topic: Owner authorizes D171 Agent identity mismatch repair and replacement standalone EXE release
facts: Owner requests immediate repair and publication of the independent D171 Windows EXE following D171_AUTH_IDENTITY_MISMATCH during Start; this is within the already-approved D171 scope, not a new change.

Source root cause identified: Windows EXE compared opaque Firebase app_user_id directly to the typed privileged login alias. Worker uses user_id as an internal key and resolves login via user_id OR employee_code. These are not interchangeable.

Patch accepts only the two preauthorized privileged Agent login aliases and requires the Worker-returned user_id, employee_code, firebase_uid and role to match the Firebase token app_user_id/sub/role; runtime Start/refresh must keep the exact bound UID and user_id. Mismatch still fails closed.

Synthetic offline regression tests cover opaque user_id distinct from login, swapped login, forged user_id, forged UID, role mismatch, missing identity, and changed refreshed token. Windows CI must run selftest before uploading artifact.

No change to production Worker, Firebase Rules, test collection, PDA APK, operational Agent, real WMS/Picklist, Stable, D170 or provider quotas. D169 remains last Owner-accepted base; D170 paused; D171 physical FIELD PASS still false.

entries.topic: Owner field logs: PDA 3/5 0/9 dual ACK and two Agents out of phase
facts: Supplied 10:33 field exports prove Agent A and B phase 0 each 9/9. During phase 1 intended A OFFICE/B NORMAL, Agent A failed with NETWORK_HTTP_FAILURE at 10:35:03, while B completed its own 9/9; the shared phase failure was not propagated.

PDA phase 1 prematurely reported both_agent_ack 9/9 at 10:33:59, well BEFORE A switched to OFFICE at 10:34:24 and began intended network test at 10:34:50; PDA result is not evidence of Office route. Android dispatchPhase triggers on a single higher-phase message and does not gate on both ready.

At phase 2 (human round 3), B announced its new phase while A remained on phase 1/Office. PDA emitted 9 synthetic messages and collected one ACK per message from B, zero from A; both_agent_ack 0/9 is a dual-ACK count and not zero individual ACKs. B timed out waiting for three party readiness.

Agent A OFFICE authenticated Firestore exact read/RTDB/Worker/token refresh probe failures observed, mixed with successful DNS/TLS and some REST HTTP_200 events: failure attributed to particular runtime routes, not definitively all Office connectivity or specific firewall settings.

Agent A logged 714 PHASE_MISMATCH_RETRY_LATER and ended with local GET/WRITE counters 1470/98; B ended 840/65. These are HTTP call approximations, not billed Firestore document operations. Failed-phase backoff/recovery missing.

Earlier 09:04 D171_AUTH_IDENTITY_MISMATCH occurred in a prior attempt; latest field session joined correctly, so not the root cause. Android earlier auth APIEXCEPTION recovered. Final ObjectDisposedException/TaskCanceledException followed the principal phase divergence.

Implementation repair proposals are recorded for Owner impact review, not implemented or approved; existing D171 isolated beta namespace only. No change to production Agent/PDA, Rules, Worker, WMS, D170 or Stable.
